title: ChatGPT just got a major upgrade. Here’s what’s new…
description:
OpenAI is bringing ChatGPT and Codex together into one connected experience, with ChatGPT Work designed to help turn rough ideas, files, and context into polished work you can actually use.

ChatGPT Work is available today in ChatGPT on web and mobile for Pro, Enterprise, and Edu, with Plus and Business rolling out over the next few days.

In the ChatGPT desktop app, Chat, Work, and Codex are available on every plan, including Free, and is available globally to download on Windows and Mac.

Download the new ChatGPT desktop app and try ChatGPT Work today.

@OpenAI  #ChatGPT_Partner
